body:
I had first gotten the word from my brother that an old friend was coming back to town, and he had some new crazy drugs with him. I had never experienced any kind of trip (except for one time I tried bunk acid and it didn't work well) and was very excited.
My friend (let's call him Blitzer) told us the drug was called 4-AcO-DMT. It had effects similar to mushrooms, and was a research chemical. He just had to convince some guys in labcoats he was doing research and he had unlimited access to the stuff. I had never tried mushrooms, and at first I was worried that it was a research chemical, but eventually I decided to give it a go. Another friend (Silver) volunteered to take the first line.
Silver was having a great time in less than 20 minutes. He was active, looking at everything, giggling, and urged me to try some. So I did. Me, Blitzer, my brother, and the last friend (Dawg) did the rest of it, snorting it.
It burned at first, like a benzo, but a little hotter. When the drug took effect not fifteen minutes later, I knew then why silver was having so much fun. I felt like I had to keep moving, as no matter where I went, I wanted a change of scenery. Everything was beautiful, and I wanted to see everything. We ventured outside and played some hackey sack while I jammed on my guitar. I wrote a lovely piece of music, and when we came inside to smoke a bowl of some decent weed, thats when I noticed my first visuals.
They were very tame, and not at all what I imagined visuals to be like. Lights flickered, waves appeared in the clouds. Just minor things that one would see if they focused on something for a very long time, except it happened without focusing. Then I noticed that everything was focused.
When we went back inside, I could only describe it as looking through 3D goggles. I never really realized what 3D was until that moment. It was like my mind finally comprehended the world I lived in. Everything was clear, focused, and my body, now weak from so much moving, was more than content to sit and enjoy a movie. We watched 'Spun', that movie about meth, and I wondered if this drug would have as many downsides as meth. Since I'm not a scientist, I suppose only time can tell.
